name: University of Fribourg
summary: University in Fribourg teaching in French and German; bachelor's applicants need one of the two languages at B2.

handoff.label: Bachelor's admission with a foreign certificate

ib.text: swissuniversities IB rule: 32/42 (2026/27), six subjects, three HL incl. maths or a science; Psychology, ESS, Global Politics and the arts don't count. French or German B2 (certificate, mother tongue or IB in it).

dates.label: Online application closes (Fribourg's standing 1 Feb – 30 Apr period)
Late applications, under specific conditions, close (same date every year)
Application closes if you need a Swiss study visa (same date every year)

notes: Sport Sciences, Special Education, Speech Therapy and Primary Education take no late applications, so 30 April is final for them.
Medicine needs a preliminary application with swissuniversities by 15 February and is open to foreign nationals only under the eligibility rules of its ordinance.
English is the teaching language only for language and literature studies and a few master's programmes.
